//go:build integration

package postgres_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	privateapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type t202Clock struct{}

func (t202Clock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }

type t202IDs struct{}

func (t202IDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

// Root executes this against an already migrated isolated owner database.
// Named initial paths are fixture inputs; objective evidence always enters the
// real registered Student HTTP handlers and shared authoritative reducer.
func TestT202PlanningStateOutboxPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := os.Getenv("STUDENT_T202_PLANNING_STATE_DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("root must provision isolated Student planning-state proof database")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil || (!t202AcceptanceDatabase(t, cfg, "student") && (cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_student_integration_proof")) {
		t.Fatal("requires exact isolated T20 root database at 127.0.0.1:58999")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if err := pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: isolated proof database unavailable")
	}
	t202AcceptanceDatabaseIdentity(t, ctx, pool)
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "t202.execution", Version: "v1"}
	now := t202Clock{}.Now()
	profile := domain.StudentOnboarding{StudentID: studentID, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "go.backend", PreferredLanguage: "en", WeeklyMinutes: 60, PreferredPace: "standard", Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	if _, err := (&postgres.StudentOnboardingRepoPG{Pool: pool}).Save(ctx, profile, 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: initial owner profile: %v", err)
	}
	primary := t202InitialPath(t, ctx, pool, studentID, target)
	secondary := t202InitialPath(t, ctx, pool, studentID, target)
	unmatched := target
	unmatched.Version = ""
	_ = t202InitialPath(t, ctx, pool, studentID, unmatched)
	_ = t202InitialPath(t, ctx, pool, uuid.NewString(), target)
	actions := postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	generalToken, practiceToken := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	handler := &privatehandlers.Handler{
		PracticeLearningActions:  studentuc.PracticeLearningActions{Actions: actions, Clock: t202Clock{}, IDs: t202IDs{}},
		PracticeLearningEvidence: studentuc.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence{Actions: actions, Clock: t202Clock{}},
		PracticeEvidence:         studentuc.ApplyPracticeEvidence{Evidence: &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}},
	}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Mount("/internal", privateapi.NewRouter(handler, generalToken, "", "", practiceToken))
	instance := uuid.NewString()
	revision := primary.Items[0].ReferenceID
	digest := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	base := fmt.Sprintf("/internal/v2/students/%s/practice-learning-actions/%s", studentID, instance)
	reservation := domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve{Schema: domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema, TaskRevisionID: revision, TaskRevisionDigest: digest, SurfaceClassification: "practice", LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}, LearningPathID: primary.ID}
	response := t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPut, base, practiceToken, instance, reservation)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("reserve status=%d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	var binding domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &binding); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	response = t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPost, base+"/open", practiceToken, "", map[string]string{"schema": domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionOpenSchema, "learning_action_id": binding.LearningActionID})
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("open status=%d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if events := t202Events(t, ctx, pool, studentID); len(events) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("reservation/open emitted objective planning fact")
	}
	evidenceID := uuid.NewString()
	evidence := domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2, PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2, EvidenceID: evidenceID, SubmissionID: evidenceID, LearningActionID: binding.LearningActionID, StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: instance, TaskRevisionID: revision, TaskRevisionDigest: digest, WorkspaceDigest: digest, Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1", Evidence: []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: target, Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 1, StepIDs: []string{"named-upstream-runtime-step"}}}, OccurredAt: t202Clock{}.Now()}
	before := t202Counts(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	// Failure after receipt/evidence/mastery/path writes proves the event joins
	// their transaction. The scoped constraint touches only this named fixture.
	constraint := "t202_outbox_failure_" + strings.ReplaceAll(evidenceID, "-", "")
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf(`ALTER TABLE student_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT %s CHECK (causation_id <> '%s') NOT VALID`, constraint, evidenceID)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if _, err := pool.Exec(context.Background(), "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "+constraint); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	response = t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPost, base+"/evidence", practiceToken, evidenceID, evidence)
	if response.Code < 400 {
		t.Fatal("outbox failure did not fail real evidence ingress")
	}
	if t202Counts(t, ctx, pool, studentID) != before {
		t.Fatal("outbox failure leaked receipt/evidence/mastery/action/path mutation")
	}
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT "+constraint); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	response = t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPost, base+"/evidence", practiceToken, evidenceID, evidence)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("retry evidence status=%d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	events := t202Events(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	if len(events) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("fanout must include selected/unselected exact paths only: %d", len(events))
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{primary.ID: true, secondary.ID: true}
	for _, event := range events {
		if err := domain.ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var envelope domain.EventEnvelope
		_ = json.Unmarshal(event.Payload, &envelope)
		var data domain.PlanningStateChangedData
		_ = json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data)
		var version int64
		if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT version FROM student_learning_path WHERE id=$1`, data.LearningPathID).Scan(&version); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !allowed[data.LearningPathID] || data.PathVersion != version || data.TriggerIdentity != evidenceID || data.TriggerKind != domain.TriggerPlanningObjectiveEvidence || len(data.Targets) != 1 || data.Targets[0] != target {
			t.Fatal("planning fact misbound to committed owner state")
		}
		for _, private := range []string{"correctness", "confidence", "workspace_digest", "step_ids", "named-upstream-runtime-step"} {
			if strings.Contains(string(event.Payload), private) {
				t.Fatal("raw evidence escaped event")
			}
		}
	}
	after := t202Counts(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	if after.evidence != 1 || after.receipts != 1 || after.audit != 1 || after.mastery != 1 || after.events != 2 || after.closed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("official evidence/mastery/trigger commit missing: %+v", after)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		response = t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPost, base+"/evidence", practiceToken, evidenceID, evidence)
		if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatal("lost response replay failed")
		}
	}
	if t202Counts(t, ctx, pool, studentID) != after {
		t.Fatal("redelivery duplicated objective state/event or path revision")
	}
	changed := evidence
	changed.WorkspaceDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)
	if response = t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPost, base+"/evidence", practiceToken, evidenceID, changed); response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("existing owner contract rejects changed evidence payload with 422: status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if t202Counts(t, ctx, pool, studentID) != after {
		t.Fatal("conflicting replay mutated owner state")
	}
	// Legacy compatibility ingress uses the same transactional fanout, without
	// creating a v2 action or pretending its event is a replan command.
	legacyID := uuid.NewString()
	legacy := domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV1, PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV1, EvidenceID: legacyID, SubmissionID: legacyID, StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: uuid.NewString(), TaskRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1", Evidence: evidence.Evidence, OccurredAt: t202Clock{}.Now()}
	legacyURL := fmt.Sprintf("/internal/students/%s/practice-evidence", studentID)
	response = t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPost, legacyURL, generalToken, legacyID, legacy)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("legacy ingress status=%d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	legacyAfter := t202Counts(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	if legacyAfter.events != 4 || legacyAfter.evidence != 2 || legacyAfter.receipts != 2 || legacyAfter.audit != 2 || legacyAfter.pathVersions != after.pathVersions {
		t.Fatal("legacy evidence commit/fanout mutated path or missed state")
	}
	response = t202HTTP(t, router, http.MethodPost, legacyURL, generalToken, legacyID, legacy)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || t202Counts(t, ctx, pool, studentID) != legacyAfter {
		t.Fatal("legacy replay duplicated commit/trigger")
	}
	if path := os.Getenv("T202_OWNER_EVENT_FILE"); path != "" {
		var selected json.RawMessage
		for _, event := range events {
			if event.CorrelationID == primary.ID {
				selected = event.Payload
			}
		}
		if len(selected) == 0 {
			t.Fatal("actual selected-path outbox event missing")
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(selected, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	t202CourseEvidenceOwnerProof(t, ctx, pool)
	t.Log("PASS actual registered v2+legacy evidence HTTP ingress → real PG objective evidence/mastery/outbox; exact multi-path fanout; forced atomic rollback/retry; lost response replay; event alone leaves path unchanged")
}

func t202InitialPath(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, studentID string, target domain.LearningTargetRef) domain.StudentLearningPath {
	t.Helper()
	now := t202Clock{}.Now()
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: studentID, CourseID: uuid.NewString(), GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "named-t202-upstream-course-fixture-v1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Named initial path fixture; no evidence or final state seeded", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}},
		{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}},
	}}
	result, replay, err := (&postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}).CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
	if err != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: initial owner path: %v", err)
	}
	return result
}
func t202HTTP(t *testing.T, router http.Handler, method, url, token, key string, input any) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(method, url, strings.NewReader(string(raw)))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}

type t202OwnerCounts struct {
	receipts, evidence, audit, mastery, events, closed int
	pathVersions                                       int64
}

func t202Counts(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, studentID string) t202OwnerCounts {
	t.Helper()
	var c t202OwnerCounts
	err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_evidence_receipt WHERE student_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_target_evidence WHERE student_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_practice_target_mastery_audit WHERE student_id=$1),(SELECT COALESCE(sum(evidence_count),0) FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject='student.planning-state.changed.v1'),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action WHERE student_id=$1 AND lifecycle_status='CLOSED'),(SELECT sum(version) FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1)`, studentID).Scan(&c.receipts, &c.evidence, &c.audit, &c.mastery, &c.events, &c.closed, &c.pathVersions)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return c
}
func t202Events(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, studentID string) []domain.IntegrationEvent {
	t.Helper()
	rows, err := pool.Query(ctx, `SELECT event_id::text,subject,schema_version,student_id::text,correlation_id,COALESCE(causation_id,''),occurred_at,payload FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject=$2 ORDER BY event_id`, studentID, domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	events := []domain.IntegrationEvent{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var event domain.IntegrationEvent
		if err := rows.Scan(&event.EventID, &event.Subject, &event.SchemaVersion, &event.StudentID, &event.CorrelationID, &event.CausationID, &event.OccurredAt, &event.Payload); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		events = append(events, event)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return events
}

// Course official outcome and Teacher assistance join are exercised through
// their real owner repositories/use case. Course/Teacher upstream facts are
// named fixtures; no final evidence/mastery rows are directly written.
func t202CourseEvidenceOwnerProof(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) {
	t.Helper()
	studentID := uuid.NewString()
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "t202.assessment", Version: "v1"}
	first, quiz := t202InitialCoursePath(t, ctx, pool, studentID, target)
	second := t202InitialPath(t, ctx, pool, studentID, target)
	now := t202Clock{}.Now()
	taskID := quiz.SourceReference.ID
	frozenTask, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"id": taskID, "_completion_fact_type": "quiz_passed", "_completion_source_revision_id": quiz.SourceReference.RevisionID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	answer := domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: studentID, TaskID: taskID, LearningPathItemID: first.Items[0].ID, RequirementID: quiz.ID, StartedAt: now, Status: domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, AnswerPayload: json.RawMessage(`{}`), FrozenTaskJSON: frozenTask}
	action, err := domain.NewStudentLearningAction(domain.StudentLearningAction{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentTaskAnswerID: answer.ID, StudentID: studentID, TaskID: taskID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLessonTask, ContextID: taskID, LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}, EvidenceClass: domain.LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, OpenedAt: now})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	lifecycle := postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	answer, action, err = lifecycle.CreateAnswer(ctx, answer, nil, action)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("named Course owner action creation: %v", err)
	}
	closedAt := now.Add(time.Second)
	closure, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosedEvent(uuid.NewString(), action, closedAt)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	assistance := domain.TeacherAssistance{EventID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: studentID, CorrelationID: action.ID, CausationID: closure.EventID, LearningActionID: action.ID, ContextType: action.ContextType, ContextID: action.ContextID, SupportContext: domain.TeacherSupportIndependent, Observations: []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{{Target: target, Kind: domain.TeacherObservationIndependentContext}}, PolicyVersion: "teacher-assistance-v1", OccurredAt: closedAt}
	ingress := studentuc.ApplyTeacherAssistance{Evidence: &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}}
	// Assistance without an official committed closure cannot invent objective
	// evidence, mastery, an inbox acknowledgment, or a planning-state trigger.
	before := t202TeacherCounts(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	if accepted, err := ingress.Handle(ctx, assistance); err == nil || accepted {
		t.Fatal("Teacher assistance without official closure became objective evidence")
	}
	if t202TeacherCounts(t, ctx, pool, studentID) != before {
		t.Fatal("rejected assistance leaked durable state")
	}
	answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed
	answer.EndedAt = &closedAt
	answer.UpdatedAt = closedAt
	action.Outcome = domain.LearningActionPassed
	action.OutcomePolicyVersion = domain.MasteryPolicyVersion
	if err := lifecycle.CloseAnswer(ctx, answer, action, closure); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("real Course official closure commit: %v", err)
	}
	if len(t202Events(t, ctx, pool, studentID)) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("closure without objective assistance join emitted planning-state trigger")
	}
	before = t202TeacherCounts(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	constraint := "t202_course_outbox_failure_" + strings.ReplaceAll(action.ID, "-", "")
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf(`ALTER TABLE student_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT %s CHECK (subject <> 'student.planning-state.changed.v1' OR causation_id <> '%s') NOT VALID`, constraint, action.ID)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if _, err := pool.Exec(context.Background(), "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "+constraint); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	if accepted, err := ingress.Handle(ctx, assistance); err == nil || accepted {
		t.Fatal("Course planning outbox failure did not roll back objective commit")
	}
	if t202TeacherCounts(t, ctx, pool, studentID) != before {
		t.Fatal("Course failed outbox leaked assistance inbox/evidence/mastery/audit")
	}
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT "+constraint); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if accepted, err := ingress.Handle(ctx, assistance); err != nil || !accepted {
		t.Fatalf("Course objective join retry: accepted=%v err=%v", accepted, err)
	}
	after := t202TeacherCounts(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	if after[0] != 1 || after[1] != 1 || after[2] != 1 || after[3] != 1 || after[4] != 1 || after[5] != 1 || after[6] != 2 || after[7] != before[7] {
		t.Fatalf("Course objective evidence/mastery/outbox commit: %v", after)
	}
	projections, err := (&postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}).ListStudentTargetMastery(ctx, studentID, []domain.LearningTargetRef{target})
	if err != nil || len(projections) != 1 || projections[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryUnderstood || projections[0].Confidence != .33333 {
		t.Fatalf("official knowledge-check mastery projection: %#v %v", projections, err)
	}
	events := t202Events(t, ctx, pool, studentID)
	for _, event := range events {
		if err := domain.ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if (event.CorrelationID != first.ID && event.CorrelationID != second.ID) || event.CausationID != action.ID || !event.OccurredAt.Equal(closedAt) {
			t.Fatal("Course planning fact does not identify official action/outcome time")
		}
	}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		if accepted, err := ingress.Handle(ctx, assistance); err != nil || accepted {
			t.Fatalf("Course assistance replay: %v %v", accepted, err)
		}
	}
	if t202TeacherCounts(t, ctx, pool, studentID) != after {
		t.Fatal("Course duplicate assistance emitted another planning event or reduction")
	}
	t.Log("PASS real Course CreateAnswer/CloseAnswer → curated Teacher ingress → PG evidence/mastery/planning-outbox atomicity, rollback/retry, exact replay; Teacher-alone rejected")
}

func t202TeacherCounts(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, studentID string) [8]int {
	t.Helper()
	var counts [8]int
	err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM student_integration_inbox WHERE student_id=$1),
 (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action_assistance WHERE student_id=$1),
 (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_evidence WHERE student_id=$1),
 (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action_target_evidence WHERE student_id=$1),
 (SELECT count(*) FROM student_target_mastery_audit WHERE student_id=$1),
 (SELECT COALESCE(sum(evidence_count),0) FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id=$1),
 (SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject='student.planning-state.changed.v1'),
 (SELECT sum(version) FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1)`, studentID).Scan(&counts[0], &counts[1], &counts[2], &counts[3], &counts[4], &counts[5], &counts[6], &counts[7])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return counts
}

func t202InitialCoursePath(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, studentID string, target domain.LearningTargetRef) (domain.StudentLearningPath, domain.LessonRequirement) {
	t.Helper()
	now := t202Clock{}.Now()
	quiz := domain.LessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: "quiz_passed", Required: true, SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString(), RevisionID: uuid.NewString()}}
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: studentID, CourseID: uuid.NewString(), GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "named-t202-assessment-course-fixture-v1", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Named initial frozen Course/quiz assignment fixture", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{
		{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), LessonRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), LessonContent: json.RawMessage(`{"title":"Named frozen quiz lesson"}`), FrozenRequirements: []domain.LessonRequirement{quiz}, Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}},
		{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}},
	}}
	result, replay, err := (&postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}).CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
	if err != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: initial frozen owner Course path: %v", err)
	}
	return result, quiz
}

// t202AcceptanceDatabase permits only the coordinator's explicit isolated fixture.
// Frozen historical fixture defaults remain available when this gate is absent.
func t202AcceptanceDatabase(t *testing.T, cfg *pgxpool.Config, owner string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return false
	}
	if !t202AcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg, owner) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: explicitly attested isolated acceptance database required")
	}
	return true
}

func t202AcceptanceDatabaseMatches(cfg *pgxpool.Config, owner string) bool {
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_PORT"))
	name := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_" + strings.ToUpper(owner) + "_DATABASE_NAME")
	host := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_HOST")
	backend := os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP")
	return !(cfg == nil || err != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 || host != "127.0.0.1" || net.ParseIP(backend) == nil || !regexp.MustCompile("^infra_acceptance_"+owner+"_[a-z0-9_]+_test$").MatchString(name) || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != host || int(cfg.ConnConfig.Port) != port || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != name || cfg.ConnConfig.User == "" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil || len(cfg.ConnConfig.Fallbacks) != 0)
}

func t202AcceptanceDatabaseIdentity(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED_FIXTURE") != "true" {
		return
	}
	var database, backend string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database(), host(inet_server_addr())`).Scan(&database, &backend) != nil || database != pool.Config().ConnConfig.Database || backend != os.Getenv("INFRA_ACCEPTANCE_POSTGRES_SERVER_IP") {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: isolated acceptance PostgreSQL backend attestation failed")
	}
}
